summary: The requirement document asks for a platform for RoadLink Cargo, which runs 140 trucks for about 300 business customers. Dispatchers plan trips, drivers use an Android app, and customers follow their parcels live. It also covers fuel and service records, monthly freight invoices, a daily link to Tally, and three years of support.

evidence.quote: Dispatchers and customers shall see trucks live on a map, with the expected arrival time at each stop.

stories: As a dispatcher, I can see trucks live on a map
As a customer, I can see trucks live on a map
As a dispatcher or customer, I can see the expected arrival time at each stop

evidence.quote: Drivers shall use an Android app to see their trips, start and finish each stop, and call the customer.

stories: As a driver, I can see my trips in the app
As a driver, I can start and finish each stop
As a driver, I can call the customer from the app

evidence.quote: Drivers shall scan the barcode on every parcel at pickup and delivery with the phone camera.
At delivery the driver shall capture the receiver's signature and a photo as proof of delivery.
